interface.shortDescription: Thinking-and-planning partner — chain of thought as a file-per-node DAG
interface.longDescription: Turns a thinking, planning, or decision discussion into a transparent chain of thought: one markdown file per node, assumption files with stale propagation, silent mechanical gates, and a regenerated DAG view. Part 1 — pre-release.

name: think-orbit
description: Single-user thinking-and-planning partner — turns a discussion into a transparent chain of thought: one markdown file per node, assumption files with stale propagation, silent mechanical gates, and a regenerated DAG view; decisions are one kind of ending, not the only one.
